status: approved module design adopted into JKRD7 on 2026-10-31; implementation evidence remains separate
definition_resolution: load imports once; recursively register pro.definitions; members contain actual JKI/JKS ids only; template placeholders are excluded until instantiated
source_resolution: pro.bindings lexical lookup; {const}, {param}, {state}, {state_ref}, {self}, and explicit by_source/by_batch selectors; selection resolved to bound identity/value, never guessed from names
dynamic_scope: explicit register operation extends the current root evaluation set; each dynamic member still needs an actual trigger delivery and its own full EX
structural_operations: performed by runtime on behalf of the owning JKS, not by J/K and never by a host business-bit algorithm
shared_node_resolution: a repeated member id within one parent instance resolves to one actual state; a different parent instance has different state; allocated public Q ids remain model-global
allocator: scan existing/static/reserved ids before starting; reserve monotonically and idempotently by operation identity; never decrement or reuse logical ids

operation_families.emit_internal/emit_and_evaluate: emit one identified bit delivery inside current root; target full EX must run; do not also enqueue a duplicate independent task
operation_families.snapshot_node_bits: lock actual q from the listed nodes and record provenance; no creation when required presence q is zero
operation_families.reserve_node_id: atomic model allocator reservation, stable on retry and retained on abort
operation_families.build_jki_draft: decode factory state/publish maps and construct six fields with empty trigger/sources; does not install an active node
operation_families.stage_reply/stage_outputs: append immutable identified records to root outbox; internal consumers may proceed, external visibility waits commit
operation_families.construct_slot: execute the declared factory sequence per actual node, configure private nodes, invoke real load EX, add valid/claim/read/control references and stage membership; no direct write_q
operation_families.evaluate_bound/load_B: bind existing values and emit one real node activation per target; state changes come only from its J/K EX
operation_families.append_slot/consume_pre/consume_and_adva: edit frame links only alongside the explicitly required q changes; preserve frame order and task identities
operation_families.admit_output_request/enqueue_preparation: ordered business request references and per-request q flags; never substitute a new execution FIFO
operation_families.lock_output_tasks/lock_H_snapshot/stage_: independent immutable per-task locks with origin identity and holder count; release predecessor only after handoff
operation_families.guard_batch/guard_bound_action: revalidate already bound metadata identity, generation, consumption and qualification; invalid becomes normal NOOP, never rebind to next head
operation_families.stage_bound_action/after_commit: a fresh independent stage call with its own root identity; child return is not a new commit boundary
operation_families.validate_fragment_detach/detach_and_dele: validate all real references and queued holders, commit full unlink/removal, then reuse only capacity with new generation and fresh logical node ids
operation_families.failure: pause/fault the admitted call retaining inputs/reservations/context; explicit retry resumes same identity; after commit retry publication only

normal_rejection_vs_fault: incomplete input/early ACK/stale ACT are normal rejection or NOOP; allocator/commit/transport errors have retained fault state
guard_semantics: guards that fail for early/stale/busy/no-candidate cases terminate this action as normal NOOP; no later mutation step runs; committed state from other calls is never rolled back
parameter_notation: JSON strings naming bound context paths and listed role recipes are declarative references evaluated by the owning JKS adapter; they are not arbitrary executable code or guessed node-name conventions
progress: each EX/delivery/operation has a call-local stable sequence entry; successful steps are not replayed on retry; parent and nested F1 share root task_id and full path identities
adopted_extensions: exclusive requester/instance ownership and allocator behavior
structural allocation/candidate/result handoff and detailed failure/recovery mechanisms
